pages.title: Take control of your digital habits
pages.description: ClearNet helps you block adult content, restrict distracting apps and maintain a safe digital environment.

pages.title: Enable local VPN protection
pages.description: Keep local VPN active to block adult websites, dangerous domains and enforce SafeSearch.

pages.title: Activate device admin & accessibility
pages.description: Prevent app uninstallation and bypass attempts during moments of temptation.

pages.title: Set a security PIN lock
pages.description: Lock app settings and blocklists behind a PIN to stop impulse modifications.

pages.title: Customise your blocklist
pages.description: Add specific websites, keywords and distracting apps to keep your blocklist effective.

pages.title: Do not disable VPN protection
pages.description: Turning off local VPN leaves your device exposed to adult content and triggers.

pages.title: Do not turn off accessibility or device admin
pages.description: Disabling core permissions creates easy bypass pathways when feeling tempted.

pages.title: Do not leave alternative browsers unblocked
pages.description: Unrestricted web browsers can become easy loopholes around domain filtering.

pages.title: Do not keep security PIN easily accessible
pages.description: Writing down or storing your security PIN nearby weakens impulse prevention.

pages.title: Do not delay adding new triggers
pages.description: When discovering a new distracting site, add it to your custom blocklist immediately.

pages.title: Do not use proxy or secondary VPN tools
pages.description: Attempting to bypass ClearNet with external proxies undermines your protection goals.

pages.title: Stay consistent daily
pages.description: Building self-control takes time. Focus on keeping your protection active uninterrupted.

pages.title: Monitor blocking statistics
pages.description: Check your dashboard regularly to see how many adult sites and apps were prevented.

pages.title: Build positive offline habits
pages.description: Replace blocked screen time with physical activity, hobbies and social connections.
